proposals.title: packages/world (2-octave price generator), packages/domain (ledger + market orders), packages/application (canonical tick loop and save)
proposals.why_now: These three packages compose the functional core required for FASE-1 acceptance. The price generator delivers INV-02. The double-entry multi-commodity ledger delivers INV-04 through INV-07. The canonical 10-step tick loop from §7 is explicitly listed in FASE-1 acceptance criteria. The save structure per ADR-006 enables CLI replay. None of these invariants are verifiable in isolation — they become testable only when composed through application, the layer that legally couples world and domain without a package-level import between them. The transcendental-function blocker (IDEA-003) must be registered and its ADR accepted before packages/world can proceed.
